manifest.description: Stripe agent plugin with skills for Stripe integrations including best practices, API and SDK upgrade guidance, and a remote MCP server configuration.

defaultPrompt: Show me the list of my top customers
Which of my products are selling best?
Help me build a coffee subscription business
interface.longDescription: Accept payments, offer financial services, and implement custom revenue models with Stripe. Includes best practices and our MCP server.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

negative.description: Debug application code where Stripe is incidental to the surrounding product context
negative.user_prompt: The settings page in our Stripe-powered SaaS application becomes unresponsive when users open the navigation menu. Review this React component and fix its state-management bug. The component does not call Stripe or process Stripe data.

negative.description: Research Stripe as a company rather than its products, APIs, documentation, or user data
negative.user_prompt: Compare Stripe and Airbnb as potential employers based on their engineering cultures, office policies, and employee reviews.

negative.description: Provide general accounting advice when Stripe is merely the source of funds
negative.user_prompt: My business receives most of its revenue through Stripe. Explain whether I should elect S corporation status and estimate the personal tax consequences using the income figures below.
